cases.purpose: Launch desktop and verify required-field validation
Baseline 20 m span, 7.5 m carriageway, no footpath, zero skew; compare dictionaries and outputs
Custom steel and concrete property propagation into analysis materials
Three consecutive designs with changed span on the same backend and desktop unlock/re-run workflow
Preservation of custom additional inputs after defaults expansion and OSI round trip
Invalid geometry: zero, negative, non-finite values and invalid girder counts
Girder, stiffener, cross-bracing, end-diaphragm and deck output coverage
Visual 3D CAD and plot generation after baseline and changed design
Compare displayed design results with output dictionary and report

evidence_policy: Record actual executions only. Distinguish source inspection, core automation, UI observation and structural-engineering verification. A successful execution does not certify structural safety.
submission_requirements: short video of custom input, three runs and CAD/plots
blocker: Desktop controller reports window minimized despite user restoration and controller reconnect; GUI sequence and video unverified.
